title: GrowthBook testimonial slider (v2)
description: A deep navy band with round outline arrow buttons top right and a row of quotes running off the right edge: each a customer wordmark, a long quote and a muted name and role. The current quote is bright with the gradient rail accent beside it, the rest dimmed; the arrows slide the row with an eased glide.
notes: needs JavaScript for the arrows (hydrate: visible)
always uses the theme's dark colours (dark class)
